a dh+yai ṣ+ya gsol ba btab cing*/ sarbān kun la/ dṛ ḍha sra ba/ kha dir / seng ldeng*/ ma yaiḥ las byung pa/ kī la kaiḥ phur bu rnams kyis/ kī la ye ta phur bus gdab/ k+ṣ+māṃ sa la zhes pa'o/ /des na 'di'i rigs kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig phrad ni/ rgya skad du ṣ+ya zhes pa'i ya btags de kho na yin pa/ nas te cing zhes sogs gang du bsgyur yang 'dra ste/ gsol ba yang btab/ phur bu yang 'debs zhes par 'gyur gyi/ snga phyi'i go rim du nam yang mi 'gyur ro/ /khyad par du yang sa lha'i cho ga dang*/ phur gdab kyi bar du de gsungs pa ni/ gsol gdab kyi tshig gnyis rigs 'dra sde tshan gcig tu mdzad pa dang*/ slob dpon med par rang kar 'jug pa dgag pa'i don yin la/ de nyid gang du byed pa'i sa mtshams ni/ 'og tu/ sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du che ge bdag kyang gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor dag ni bzheng bar bgyid/ ces pa 'di yin te/ de'i de ma thag tu/ dag pa'i gnas ni legs par gang zhing shin tu mnyam par bkod pa rus sbal rgyab bzhin mtho ba dag /ces sogs rdzas lnga sta gon byed par gsungs shing bzheng bar bgyid ces pa'i rjes su/ gang dag phyogs rnams kun nas sogs sprel rgyu yin pa shin tu gsal ba'i phyir dang*/ rgyud don phyin ci ma log par dgongs pa rnams kyi man ngag las kyang 'byung ngo*/ /mkhas mchog bu ston gyis kyang sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du/ zhes sogs kyis lha sta gon bstan par bzhed na/ de las brgyud par 'dod pa kha cig ni rang nyid lha sta gon 'og tu byed pa de kho na snying la bzhag nas 'di skad du/ de mi 'thad de 'di ni slob ma srung ba byas pa'i rjes su slob ma la bar chad mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs pa tsam yin zer ba ni/ dkyil 'khor dag ni bzheng bar bgyi/ zhes pa'i tshig don med du btang ba dang*/ gang dag phyogs rnams kun na zhes sogs kho na tsam zhig gzhan du skyogs pa tsam la sems tshim par zad do/

/'di ni spyi rgyud las 'byung ba'i snyan gsan dbab pa dang don gcig ste/ 'dir sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du zhes pa dang*/ slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*/ zhes sogs don gcig la/ che ge bdag kyang sogs dang*/ mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid sogs don gcig /gang dag phyogs rnams kun na sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor sogs don gcig /mchog gis thugs rjes sogs dang*/ bdag ni rdo rje che ge can/ sogs don gcig pas/ sems can rnams ni sogs dang*/ gang dag phyogs rnams kun na sogs sbrel dgos par nges shing*/ de yang tshig rkang gsum po de snyan gsan dbab par go dgos pa dang*/ rgyud gzhan gyi lugs kyi snyan gsan dbab pa/ bcom ldan che ge mo zhes mchog ces sogs med kyang*/ gong mas rang lugs la chog pa dang*/ spros pa la mos na don gcig pa'i phyir gnyis ka byas kyang mi 'gal bar go bar bya yi/ kha cig ltar 'brel med kyi cal col la legs bshad du brdzu bar mi bya'o/ /yang de dag 'di skad ces rgyud gzhan la bum pa sta gon gyi sngon du lha sta gon byed kyang*/ dus 'khor la ni mi rung ste mal stan lhag gnas kyi sngon du rdzas lnga sta gon 'gro dgos par bshad la/ mal stan lhag gnas kyis rmi lam brtags nas/ ngan na re zhig thig mi 'debs par bgegs gzhom pa byed la/ bzang na gdong thig 'debs dgos pa yin par dus 'khor ba thams cad 'dod dgos la/ thig ma btab par lha sta gon mi rung ste las thig ma btab pa la lhag gnas kyi lha'i gnas nges thub pa mi srid/ lhag gnas kyi lha so so'i gdan gyi sar rdul tshon gyi lha mtshan rnams ma 'chol bar dgos pa'i phyir/ rdzas lnga lhag gnas de ring byas pa'i nang bar las thig btab nas lha lhag gnas byed pa yin no zhes smra zhing*/ 'di ba'i dus 'khor du ma zad rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor che chung gang la yang*/ las thig sngon du ma song bar lha sta gon mi rung ste/

lhag gnas kyi sa gzhi nges mi thub pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di kho na yang skyor zhe skyor rgyu mtshan du 'god cing*/ ye thig rjes su las thig byed pa nam yang mi rung bar smra'o/ /'di ni smra ba po de rnams nyid blo gros shin tu che ba'i rlom pa yod kyang*/ 'phral gyi bya ba la bye brag phyed pa'i spyang grung gi rig pa med pa zhig ste/ lha lnga nas sum cu tsam gyi bar la thig la ma bltos par mig tshod shin tu 'grig por yod pa da lta yang shin tu mang la/ blos khyad par las dus 'khor yongs rdzogs lta bu lha shin tu mang ba la yang mig tshod mi 'chug pa'i blo rnon po da ltar yang yod srid na/ sngon gyi mi blo grim po dag la lta ci smos/ de la khyed 'di ltar sems te/ blo gros yangs po de lta bu la yang mig tshod de 'dra ba med na/ gzhan dag la lta ci smos snyam 'dug ste/ nga rgyal gyi rtsa ba can gyi gti mug glen rtags so/ /yang de'i rjes 'brang kha cig dus 'khor la thig btab pa'i rjes su lha sta gon byed dgos te/ 'grel chen las/ 'dir thig btab cing lha'i gnas thams cad sbyangs par gyur pa na/ de nas dri dang me tog la sogs pa dang*/ gtor ma byin te phyi nas rdul tshon dgye ba brtsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs zer ba ni/ lung gi rgyab rten ma rnyed pa'i ci zer zad pa ste/ 'di'i don ni thig legs par btab pas/ lha so so'i bzhugs gnas thams cad kyang sbyangs pa ste dag cing ma nor bar gyur zin pa na/ de rjes srung ma drug cu dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'am mkha' 'gro ma la gtor ma sbyin/ de nas rdul tshon 'gyed ces pa'i don kho na yin pas so/ /des na skabs 'di'i lha lhag gnas ni sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba gdab pa de yin la/ de ni rdzas lnga sta gon gyi sngon du gsal bar gsungs pa las 'god par mi bya'o/ /yang 'di snyam du de ltar yin du chug kyang mig tshod 'grig po dkon pa'i phyir/

lha lhag gnas kyi sngon du thig mi 'debs pa'i thabs med snyam na/ lhag gnas ma 'chol bar byed pa'i tha snyad 'di ni/ rgya bod kyi slob dpon phyi ma rnams kho na la grags pa yin pa'i phyir khungs shin tu chung la/ sgos su dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs la de lta bu rtsi dgos pa yin pa kho na'o/ /rang lugs la gcig tu dgos pa ma yin yang gzhan dor byed pa dang bla chos la ni tshad mi bzhag go /des na rgya bod kyi sngags pa 'ga' zhig gis thig tshon gyi las byed pa glen blun mang po dag 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ lha sta gon gyi sngon du thig 'debs par byed cing yi ger yang 'god pa ni/ lhag gnas mi 'chol ba'i phyir skam thig tsam 'debs pa las thig chog mi byed cing*/ las thig phyis 'debs pa yin pa la/ bod pa rjes ma rnams kyis las thig 'debs thengs gcig po des go nyis chod byed pa'i bla chos kyi lag len nor ba byas pa de/ lag len yang dag tu sgrub pa'i ngo bo'i ci zhig bya/ 'dis ni nor ba de yang dag tu 'bad pas sgrub pa dang*/ ma nor pa la nor ro zhes gya gyu can du gsal bar byed pa'o/ /rgya gzhung dkyil chog khung ma thams cad las lhag gnas kyi rjes su thig 'debs pa kho na yod cing/ de yang ye thig 'ba' zhig ma yin te/ dkar thig nges par gdab dgos pa'i phyir na/ dkyil chog shin tu bsdus pa re re tsam ma gtogs/ las thig 'phros gleng med par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang med pa'i phyir/ gsal kha ma gsungs pa rnams ni las ye lhan cig tu ston pa yin no/ /des na dkyil chog gzhan rnams kyi lugs la sngon la las thig btab nas ye thig gis byin gyis rlobs pa'i lugs gcig dang*/ sngon la ye thig yid kyis phab nas de'i tshe dbye ba'i phyir las thig 'debs pa gnyis yod la/ 'dir ni las ye'i dbye ba med de/ rdo rje'i thig ces pa kho nar zad do/ /des na lha sta gon gyi gong du thig chog dgos pa la rgyu mtshan med cing gnod byed yod pas log rtog la zhen par mi bya'o/

/da ni 'dir med du mi rung ba'i gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga ni 'di tsam zhig ste/ nam mkha'i dbyings su gsol ba gdab pa'i yul nges can gdod nas grub pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bzhugs pa gsal btab cing*/ yul nges med phyi nang phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa gsal btab nas mchod pa rgya cher bshams byin gyis brlabs te/ mchod bstod phul zhing*/ sems can rnams ni sogs tshig rkang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ gnang ba stsal bar bsam pa tsam zhig yin la mchod pa ni rgyas pa nyid bzang ngo*/ /'di ni rgyud 'grel gyi dngos bstan nyid yin pas dngos gnas la skyon med yon tan kun ldan lhag chad bral ba nyid yin la/ dkyil chog 'jug pa'i dngos bstan dkyus ni/ dus phyis bod du chog grwa byed pa la bkod pa mdzes shing tshig 'dod gyi spros pa ha cang ches pa min tsam zhig dgos pa byung bas don dang mi 'gal pa la/ lag len lhag po cung zad kyis brgyan par byas pa 'di yang bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag yin zhing*/ lha sta gon gyi tha snyad sbyor pa'i phyir legs pa'ang yin no/ /'di la lhag gnas kyi sngon 'gro ni bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la rkyang nul byed pa dang*/ skam thig ci rigs pa 'debs pa dang*/ lha'i gdan du dri bzang gi thig le'am tshom bu dgod pa dang*/ mchod gtor shom pa rnams yin la/ dngos gzhi ni bsangs sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor skad cig gis bskyed mgron rnams spyan drangs/ phyi mchod nang mchod sogs mchod bstod ji ltar 'os pa bya/ gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su snyan gsan phab cing gtor ma 'bul/ rjes ni mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ mchod bstod gsol 'debs kha skong bzod gsol gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis rnams so/ /de dag las sngon 'gro'i skabs su dris byug thig gdab tshom bu gsum/

dngos gzhi'i skabs su bsangs sbyangs mgron spyan 'dren snyan gsan dbab pa gsum/ rjes chog ril po rnams rgyud 'grel las dngos su mi gsal ba'i kha skongs lhag po yin no/ /gtor ma 'bul ba ni gsol btab kyi yan lag rang min yang lhag gnas kyi nyin mo nges par byed dgos pas rgyud 'grel las ma bshad pa'i lhag po kha skongs kyi rigs ma yin no/ /gnyis pa rdzas lnga lhag gnas las/ dang po bum pa lhag gnas la bum pa'i rgyu/ bum pa'i tshad/ bum pa'i grangs/ nang rdzas kyi nges pa/ bskyed chog gi tshul la dpyad pa ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ rgyud las/ de bzhin shel gyi bum pa dang ni dngul mchog rang bzhin dpal ldan thod pa dag dang lcags kyi dang*/ / zangs zhes bya dang gser gyi bum pa rab gsal nges par shing las skyes dang sa yi rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ zhi ba la shel gyi bum pa/ rgyas pa la dngul/ bsad pa la mi'i thod pa/ bskrad pa dang dbye ba la lcags/ dbang la gser/ dgug pa la zangs/ rengs pa la sa/ rmongs pa la shing gi bum pa/ zhes gsungs la/ dbang bskur dang rab gnas sogs la las thams cad pa dang mtshungs te/ de yang tshad zhi rgyas dbang gsum gang rung dang mtshungs pa las/ rgyu ni gser dngul shel gsum gang rung byed pa mchog gam spyi 'gros dbang du byas pa yin la/ ma snyed na sa'i khams las byas pa rdza bum gyis kyang rung ngo*/ / shel dang dngul rang mdog dkar po nyid kyis chog cing gser yang rang mdog nyid kyis chog pas dkar por bsgyur mi dgos la/ sa las byas pa yin na kha dog dkar por bsgyur bar bshad do/ /las so so la ni/ gser dngul zangs lcags shel rnams rang mdog dang*/ thod pa dur khrod kyi sol pa dang mi'i zhag gis byugs pas nag po dang*/ sa dang shing gi bum pa ser por bya'o/ /gnyis pa bum pa'i tshad ni/ zhi rgyas la lto ba zlum po'i sbom sa'i rgyar sor bcu drug pa/ lto ba rang gi dpangs la sor bcu bzhi/

bum pa yongs rdzogs kyi dpangs su sor nyi shu/ mchu 'phyang sor gnyis/ mgrin pa'i dpangs la spyir sor drug yod kyang gnyis mchu 'phyang gi 'og tu song bas sor bzhi/ kha'i rgyar ni sor brgyad/ de la cha gsum du bgos pa'i dbus ma cha gnyis ni/ kha'i bu ga mgul ba'i sbubs yin la/ g.yas g.yon gyi cha phyed pa re re ni kha g.yel ba yin zhes te don la cha drug tu btang ba'i dbus kyi cha bzhi bu ga ste/ rags rtsis su sor lnga kha'i bu ga dang*/ kha'i 'dab ma'i zheng sor phyed gnyis re'o/ /'di'i sor yang mthe bo'i sor la tshad bzhag go /rengs pa'i las la lto ba sgos kyi dpangs la sor bcu gnyis/ spyir sbom thung rgya dpangs mnyam pa sor bcu drug /mgrin pa'i dpangs su sor bzhi/ mchu 'phyang 'thug po sor gnyis/ kha'i rgyar sor drug /bskrad pa dang dbye ba la lto ba chung ba ste zlum skor rgyar sor bcu gnyis/ mgrin pa sor brgyad sum 'khyog can/ mchu sor gcigadapangs su sor nyer bzhi/ kha'i rgya sor drug sum cha bu ga'o/ /bsad pa la ni thod pa bya ril te lag khung bum pa'i kha yin par bya'o/ /yang kha cig thod pa bsgrigs pa'i bum par yang 'dod mod mi legs la/ gzhan dag thod phor la 'dod kyang thod phor ni/ bsad pa'i las la rnam rgyal chen po yin pa'i phyir/ bum pa dang rnam rgyal chen po 'di gnyis la dbye ba phyed pa zhig dgos par snang bas snga ma kho na 'thad do/ /dbang dgug la bzo bos ji ltar byas pa las dbyibs dang tshad kyi nges pa med do/ /rmongs pa la gsal kha med kyang rengs pa dang 'dra la/ las thams cad pa la ni/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum gang rung dang mtshungs par sbyar ro/ /de la bum pa rnams rtsa ba dang nag po med pa zhes pa ni/ rdza bum yin na so btang ba'i dus su nag thig med pa dang dbang dgug ma gtogs pa la rtsa ba ste zhabs stegs med pa'o/ kha dog dkar por bsgyur pa ni/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i lde gu'am/

'bras btags pa'i khu bas byug cing*/ tha na sa dkar gyis kyang rung ngo*/ /gsum pa bum pa'i grangs ni/ rgyud 'di'i lugs la dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs phyin chad legs par 'byor na lnga bas nyung ba ma gsungs shing*/ mang na lha'i grangs sam/ de bas kyang mang ba mtha' med pa'i bar du rung ngo*/ /'on kyang lnga'am bcu'i grangs gtso che la/ de la spyir rgyud 'dir gzugs ming mtshungs pa'i bum pa ni lnga'am bcu yin la/ gzugs ming mi mtshungs pa ni/ lnga'i phyogs la rnam rgyal bum pa ste drug pa dang*/ bcu'i phyogs la rnam rgyal chen po ste bcu gcig pa'o/ /de gnyis ni bum pa'i ming yod kyang gzugs ni dung chos sam thod pa'am mchod yon gyi snod do/ /des na rnam rgyal chen po la ni bum gzugs ma yin pas khyab la/ phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi bum pa brgyad dang*/ rgyal ba'i bum pa ni bum gzugs can yin pas khyab cing*/ rnam rgyal gnyis ka yod de/ bum gzugs lnga'i phyogs la rnam rgyal dung chos yin zhing*/ bcu'i phyogs la bum pa'i gzugs nyid yin pas so/ /bcu las mang bar gyur na/ gcig lhag na gtso bo yab yum/ gnyis lhag na yab yum so so dang*/ gsum lhag na gtso bo yab yum dang 'khor tshogs spyi/ bzhi lhag na 'khor la thugs dkyil dang*/ gsung dkyil phan chad gnyis/ lnga dang drug la gsung dkyil/ sku dkyil la re re dang*/ bde chen 'khor lo la yang logs su bya/ yang na lnga gtso bo dang rigs bzhi/ drug rigs drug sogs mthar drug brgya sum cu so drug gi bar du lha grangs dang mnyam par rung la/ de bas lhag na gtso bo la bum pa bcu byed pa sogs tshul des rigs bsgre ba yin yang*/ da lta nye bar mkho ba ni lnga'am bcu gang rung ngo*/ /der ma zad bum pa du ma zhig byed pa ni/ rab gnas dang mchog sgrub kyi dbang bskur dang*/ las thams cad pa dang zhi rgyas rnams la yin gyi/ las lhag ma rnams la bum pa bcu las mang ba mi rung ngo*/

/bcu la rnam rgyal chen po dang lnga la rnam rgyal yang rab gnas sogs zhi rgyas kyi bar la dung chos dang*/ bsad bskrad dbye gsum la thod pa dang*/ dbang dgug la zangs dang gser/ rmongs rengs la kham phor zhes gsungs te so btang pa ni yin no/ /de dag la yang khyab bya khyab byed kyi dbye ba yod de/ rgyud las/ klu dang bzhi yi nor bu gser gyi bum pa dag ste rgyal po sa yi rang bzhin rin chen bcas/ zhes gsungs te/ bum pa bcu'i phyogs la khyab bya phyogs mtshams kyi bum pa brgyad/ lnga'i phyogs la khyab bya phyogs kyi bum pa bzhi/ zhes bya ste/ de yang bcu la phyogs bzhi dang*/ steng rgyal ba ni/ rgyal pa'i bum pa nyid du gtogs shing*/ 'og rnam rgyal dang mtshams bzhi ni rnam rgyal nyid du gtogs la/ rnam rgyal chen po ni bcu po kun la khyab pa'o/ lnga ltar na shar byang steng gsum rgyal ba'i phyogs/ lho nub dung chos gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyogs so/ /de thams cad la rgyal ba'i phyogs rnams thabs dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi phyogs rnams shes rab tu bya'o/ /'dir las bum ni/ snga rabs pa rnams phal che ba mdzad pa yin par 'dug pas/ rtags mngon gyur gyi phyag len dgag par mi bya mod/ 'on kyang rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa ni rnam rgyal chen po'am rnam rgyal dung chos kyis bsangs pas kyang chog /sbyin sreg gi skabs su gsungs pa ltar yi ge drug pas bsangs chu logs su bsgrubs kyang rung ste/ las bum gyi bya ba des byed do/ /de dag gis bum pa rang gi mtshan nyid bshad zin nas/ da ni yo byad rnams bshad na/ bum pa rnams kyi gdan ni rkos ma'am/ tshem bus btsems pa'am/ sa las byas pa'am/ ras bris sam rdul tshon gang yin yang rung ste/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rnam pa bya la/ kha rgyan yang dngul lam shing sogs las pad+ma dkar po'i rnam pa'am/ pad+ma dngos bod du mi rnyed kyang me tog dkar po phal pas kyang rung bar mngon/

lcug ma'i yal ga ni nges par dgos la/ mgul bcings ni/ las so so la las mthun dang*/ spyi 'gro la gos gtsang ma thams cad dkar rkyang ngam sair rkyang ngam dkar ser phyed pas kyang rung zhing*/ kha cig phyogs mdog tu byed pa'ang 'gal ba med de/ gang ltar yang stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mtshon byed gos zung dang*/ rigs sngags kyi nus pa brtan byed dang tshangs skud mtshon byed dang bkra shis pa'i don du bum pa'i mgul par srad bu dkar pos lan bdun dkri/ bum pa'i mtshan ma ni/ rnam rgyal la sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla sgra gcan gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rwa gsum pa dang*/ rgyal ba la ljang khu rtse lnga'o/ /yang na rgyal ba la rdo rje dang*/ rnam rgyal la gri gug go /shar dang shar lho la ral gri/ lho dang lho nub la rin po che/ nub dang nub byang la 'khor lo/ byang dang byang shar la pad+ma rnams phyogs mdog dang*/ de dag kyang pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la 'god par byed do/ /bsdu na bum mtshan kun la gdan med kyang chog /sā dhu pu tras lho nub la pad dmar dang*/ byang shar du ut+pal byed pa ni yum bzhi'i bum pa yin pa'i dbang du byas par snang ste/ rang lugs la bum pa rnams rigs lnga yum lnga'i bum pa ma yin pa'i phyir de 'dra mi dgos te/ khams drug mtshon byed kyi mtshan ma tsam yin no/ /bzhi pa nang rdzas ni/ rgyud 'grel las 'byung ba rnams sdoms su bya na/ rdo rje pha lam kha dog dbye bas lnga/ /dbang sngon pad dmar chu shel karke ta/ /margad rnams ni rin chen mchog lnga yin/ /mu tig byu ru mu men shū la dang*/ /thig le drug pa rin chen 'bring po yin/ /shel dang dzī ba dzā ti ḍau ha ri/ /'ching bu shel ljang rin chen tha ma lnga/ /gser dngul zangs lcags khab len bzhu ba'i lcags/ /lcags lnga zhes grags de ltar nyer lnga las/ /rin chen gang rung lnga dang lcags lnga bzung*/ /ga pur sug smel pri ka si h+ya dang*/ /bla sgang rnams ni lnga tshan dang po yin/

/sing ha mu dra ka kol pri yang ku /a kar nag dang shai len gnyis pa yin/ /gla rtsi dzā ti gur gum mu ra dang*/ /ru rta rnams ni lnga tshan gsum pa'o/ /pu tra ke sha ta ma la 'dab dang*/ /nā ga ke sar tsan+dan u shī ra/ /de rnams dri bzang lnga tshan bzhi pa'o/ /bhe ruṇ+ḍa brun rgya spos me tog dang*/ /sngo sman 'khri shing gla rtsir grags pa dang*/ /spang spos bā la ka rnams lnga pa ste/ /de rnams dri bzang sde tshan nyer lnga'o/ /khyab 'jug gnon dang tshangs pa'i dbyug pa dang*/ / drag po'i ral pa de bzhin pra si bha/ /de ba dā li sde tshan ri bong can/ /a dho puṣ+pa kar+ṇi ka dang ni/ /in+d+ra ba ru ṇī dang la k+ṣa ṇa/ /phag gi rna ba zhes bya'i sngo sman ni/ /sman gyi sde tshan mig gi grangs su brjod/ /dz+yo ti s+ya ti du byed ladz+dza lu ā/ / arka mu ṣa li rnams 'jig rten no/ /lnga tshan bzhi pa pu traṃ dzā ri dang*/ /mo ha ne dang ha sa de ba dang*/ /kri ta ñdza li a dza kar ṇa'o/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri shing mngar rma bya'i gtsug /bri ha ti dang bhaṃ ga rā dza ri/ /lnga tshan dbang po yin te nyi shu lnga/ /so ba chen po so ba mon sran dang*/ /tsa na dkar po til nag lnga tshan gzugs/ /gro dang til dkar dang ni ko tra pa/ /mud ga sran ma lnga tshan bgrod par brjod/ /yu nag tri pu ṭā dang nas 'bru dang*/ /mon sran auṣ+ṭha zhes pa lnga tshan me/ /sran chung parba ṭi kā yungs kar dang*/ /khra rgod tu ba ri ni chu gter yin/ /ku lan tha dang bar+ṇ+ṇa tsa na nag /a ta shi dang kha ra ḍi rnams ni/ /'bru yi sde las lnga tshan mda' yin no/ /rin chen lnga po rnyed par ma gyur na/ /me tog kha dog lngas kyang dod thub yin/ /lnga tshan re re bzhin du cha gcig nas/ /cha lnga'i bar du blo yis sbyar bar bya/ cha gcig mkha' ye'i khams yin steng 'og dang*/ /cha gnyis rlung shar cha gsum me ste lho/ /cha bzhi byang chub cha lnga nub ste sa/ /zhes so/ /de yang bum pa rnams su thur bur mi byed pa gtso che la/

rnam rgyal dung chos sam rnam rgyal chen por lnga tshan lnga po thams cad bsdoms pa'i thum bu nges par 'jug par bshad/ de la lnga tshan lnga ni rin po che lnga/ lcags lnga/ dri lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga rnams yin la/ de dag las khams lnga'i rim pa gang rnyed pa res chog pa yin pas/ bod du rnyed bla ba rnams ni dkyil chog 'jug par bris pa bzhin yin/ zhib par dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho'i nyid dang*/ rgyud 'grel gyi chu dbang gi skabs dang*/ nang le'i dri bzang gi le tshe'i skabs su blta bar bya la/ sman gyi ngos 'dzin lo paṇa gyi ngag sgros yin gyu ba dang*/ u rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyis rtsad bcad pa yin zer ba sogs sngar mang po bris 'dug pa de rnams la yid brtan thub pa rang yang dka' bar snang bas btang snyoms su bzhag go /de la bhai ru n+ṭa'i brun dang*/ rma bya'i gtsug phud ces pa lta bu sngo sman gyi rigs la ming de skad thog pa dag yin gyi/ brun dang sgro min no/ /sman gzhan rnams cha che chung gi tshad zho char gzhal te yang lji'isgo nas cha mang nyung gi tshad byed la/ 'bru rnams 'bru'i grangs la rtsi ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ de yang bum pa rnams gu gul gyis bdugs/ yig drug bzlas pa'i yungs dkar gyis grabs legs par bkrus te/ gos zung dang srad bus dkri/ gdan la bzhag nas chu gtsang rnyog pa med pas bkang*/ rigs drug bzla bzhin du snying po rnams gzhug par bya'o/ /badz+ra shi ṣa re'i sngags dang*/ oṃ ta b+tai sogs/ khro bo dgug pa'i sngags rnams 'dir mi dgos te/ de dag ni gzhan gyis kha 'gengs yin pa tsam du ma zad/ lugs gzhan la'ang gal che ba ma yin pas so/ /lnga pa bum bskyed kyi tshul la/ gzhan lugs rang lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dus zhabs pa'i dkyil chog na/ haṃ las bum pa gzhal yas khang*/ paṃ las chu 'o ma'i rgya mtsho zhes 'dod/ sā dhu pu tras paṃ las bum par bskyed/ bod snga rabs 'ga' zhig bh+ruṃ las bskyed kyang*/

rgyud 'grel gyi dngos bstan du gsungs pa'i bum pa'i sa bon dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ man ngag ltar snang yin pas snying po med la/ mkhas pa kha cig kyang dung chos su dkyil 'khor rdzogs par sgom pa'i rgyab rten du/ kyai rdor gyi 'grel pa pad+ma can las/ thams cad chu las khams phor du/ /nyung tshad blugs te rnam rgyal gyi/ /bum pa paṃ las bskyed pa yi/ /rin chen bum pa steng bzhag bya/ /der ni dkyil 'khor bskyed bya ste/ /zhes pa 'dren te/ de ni bum par dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i go ba yin gyi/ der ni zhes pa dung chos la 'chad pa go lugs nyes pa'o/ /gzhan yang bod kyi dus 'khor bar 'dod pa phyis byung phal cher bum mtshan rnams lhar bskyed pa dang*/ bum pa so so'i nang du rigs lnga yum bcas tsam mam/ rigs lnga yab yum bcu tsam bskyed pa dang*/ phyogs phyogs kyi lha rnams phyogs phyogs kyi bum pa so sor bskyed pa sogs lha bskyed chog rgyas bsdus sna tshogs dang*/ rnam rgyal chen por ji tsam dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha de tsam bskyed zer ba dang*/ lha thams cad kyang rigs drug byin rlabs/ ye shes dgug gzhug rgyas btab sogs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ya swāhā/ zhes sogs kyi blo bzo'i sngags mang po dang*/ bum pa la 'dud nyi shu'i bstod pa byed pa sogs/ mdor na mtshan pa'i rnam g.yeng du mas rgyud dkrugs shing*/ rgyud gzhan la rgya bod kyi slob dpon gzhan gyis sbyar ba'i dkyil chog rnams na/ bum bskyed la lha tshogs bskyed pa/ de'i rgyas ma khebs kyis dogs nas dran rkyen mang po byas pa der 'dug /des na rgyud 'dir thig tshon bum pa rdor dril zhes/ gtso che chung 'dra rung khyad med kyi sgo nas lhag gnas sngar bshad pas/ de dag cho ga rgyas bsdus kyang 'dra rung bar 'thad la/ rgyud gzhan dang lugs gzhan la sgrig mi dgos te/ de dag la rdor dril lhag gnas med cing*/

thig tshon byin rlabs kyang lhag gnas su mi byed pas/ rdzas kyi lha gnas 'dra mtshungs brtsi rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni rang lugs kyi bum bskyed 'di tsam gyis chog gi lugs gzhan spros pa lhur len pa rnams la lhag pa'i skyon yod pa'i rgyu mtshan dang po yin no/ /rgyud 'grel gyi gnas skabs gang na yang bum bskyed la lha zhal phyag can dgos pa'i dngos bstan shugs bstan gang yang ma byung ba 'di ni rgyu mtshan gnyis pa yin no/ /rgyud 'grel las/ thig tshon gyi ye shes pa rigs lnga yum lnga rnams thig tshon nyid kyi rnam par spyan 'dren par gsungs pas/ yar la bum pa dang 'og tu byis 'jug gi dbang rdzas thams cad kyi bar du de ltar go dgos la/ ye shes pa thig tshon gyi rnam par spyan drangs phyin/ dam tshig pa yang thig tshon gyi rnam pa las 'os med de/ dam ye mtshungs pa spyir yang sngags pa kun gyi lugs dang*/ sgos su rgyud 'di las kyang che thang du mdzad pa ro mnyam gyi skabs sogs las shes so/ /de'i phyir 'di ni rgyu mtshan gsum pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyud rgyal 'di las/ sku gzugs dang glegs bam sogs gtso che shos 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ brtan pa'i dngos po la byin rlabs kyi skabs zhal phyag gi rnam pa can bskyed pa rtsal 'don ma mdzad pas/ spyi'i rig pa de 'di la'ang sbyor dgos pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /yang 'di'i bum pa brgyad ni/ bde chen 'khor lo'i bum pa brgyad dang don gcig pas/ de dag nus ma rnams kyi thabs gsang zhing sbas pa'i sku yin pa'i phyir/ lha gzhan thams cad zhal phyag tu bzhengs pa'i bskyed rim sgom pa'i sde tshan la yod skabs kyang*/ de dag rnam pa bum pa las gzhan du mi bzhengs na/ 'dir zhal phyag gi rnam pa'i lha mi dgos pa'i sde tshan la yod pa'i skabs lta smos kyang ci dgos te rgyu mtshan lnga pa'o/ /yang khyed mang po dag thig tshon rnams rang rang gi sa bon las ngo bo lha yin yang rnam pa thig tshon nyid las gzhan du mi bsgyur ba'i dam ye bsre ba byed kyin 'dug na/

de dag dang 'di la rgyu mtshan khyad par med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ lugs 'di la sgrub byed dang*/ bum pa zhal phyag can la gnod pa can gyi tshad ma ste/ rgyu mtshan drug pa'o/ /yang de dag mi mtshungs te dbang bskur ba'i dus su bum pa gtso che bas zhal phyag tu bskyed dgos so snyam na ma yin te/ bum pa bas thig tshon gal che ste/ thig tshon gyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor med na bum pa'i bya ba stong pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa gang gtso che rnag rji mos kyang go ba ma yin nam/ khyaid dag rang lugs la nor ba zhig sngon du khas blangs na/ de'i ltag mi 'chor ba'i phyir/ nor pa la nor par shes bzhin du yang ye nas khas mi len par lung rig ltar snang sad sud 'dra nyag nyug kho na byed cing*/ yang dag pa'i lugs la sdang smras 'ba' zhig lhur len pa ni/ phyogs 'dzin gyi gdon gyis bslad pas spyang thal ches te rmongs pa rang mgo rang gis bskor ba ste/ 'on kyang bden te gang la skyon chags pa ni dus ngan pa 'di'o/ /yang 'ga' zhig skabs 'dir bum par lha ma bskyed na/ phyis chu dbang bskur ba don med de lha zhu ba'i chu ma yin pa'i phyir ro zer ba ni mu cor te/ skabs 'dir lhar ma bskyed kyang phyis dbang bskur gyi tshe lhar bskyed pa ni shin tu mang ste/ dkyil chog gzhan gyi lugs la dbu rgyan dang rdor dril bzhin no/ /des na der ma bskyed pas 'dir bskyed du mi rung ba ma yin la/ 'dir ma bskyed pas der bskyed du mi rung pa'ang ma yin no/ /dngos gnas ni/ kho bo cag skabs 'di dang*/ dbang gi dngos gzhi sogs thams cad du bum pa dang bum chu gnyis kar lhar bskyed mnyam la zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du ni ma yin par mnyam pas kyang gnas skabs gnyis la mi mtshungs pa'i skyon ni med la lar mtshungs pa dgos pa yang ma yin no/ /gal te mtshungs par dgos na ni khyed rnams nyid la skyon te/

bum pa sta gon gyi skabs kyi lha dang*/ chu dbang bskur ba'i skabs kyi lha gnyis gcig gam mi gcig ces brtags na dus 'khor gyi dkyil chog gam gzhan gyi dkyil chog gang yin yang 'dra ste/ gzod go ba rnyed par 'gyur gyi/ chags sdang phrag dog drag pos sems had had por gyur pa'i skabs su thabs ci byas kyang nges pa ster bar mi nus so/ /nged kyi lugs la'ang chu dbang gi chu ni lha'i ngo bo yin te/ sngags kyi yig 'bru las yang dag par sprul pa'i phyir dang*/ lha'i ngo bor lhag par mos pa'i phyir ro/ /lar khyed 'dra ba mtshan nyid pa skam pos sngags pa byas pa na/ lha'i gal che shos yig 'bru'i lha nam yang rtsad ma chod par 'dug la/ lha'i mos pa brtan pos kyang lhar mi 'gyur na/ sngon du lha bskyed chog byas nas zhu ba'i bum chu yang khyed ltar na lha'i rang bzhin ma yin par 'gyur te/ lha de yin snyam pa'i mos pas ni lhar mi 'gyur/ dngos dang dmigs pa gang gi sgo nas kyang zhal phyag gi rnam par mi 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar med kyang lha bskyed pa sngon 'gro can yin pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ bdag bskyed sa chog gsol gdab sogs 'dir yang lha bskyed pa du ma sngon du song ngo*/ /ma yin te gzhi de la dgos so snyam na/ bum pa 'jog pa'i sngon du lha lhag gnas byas pa ma shes sam/ ma yin te dbang rdzas nyid lhar bskyed pa dgos so snyam na/ 'o na dbang rdzas ni bum chu yin la/ khyed rnams bum chu'i steng gi nam mkha' la lha bskyed pas cir 'gyur/ lha sku las bum chu byung zhing*/ lha bum chu'i rgyu yin pas chu de lha'i rang bzhin no snyam na/ de ni mi 'thad de/ yul dngos po ltar na chu ni chu nyid kyi rigs 'dra snga ma'i rgyun las byung ba yin gyi/ rnal 'byor pa'i yid ngor bsgoms pa'i lha sku las byung ba ga la yin/ mos pa'i dbang du byas pa'o snyam na/ lha las byung ba'i bum chu'o snyam pas lha'i rang bzhin du 'gro na/

nged kyang bum pa dang bum chu 'di ni lha yin no snyam mos pa nan tan du byed pas ci'i phyir bum chu lha'i ngo bo ma yin/ des na sngar gtan la ma phab pa thams cad la cho ga gzhan phyogs re tsam mthong ba'i mig gis tshod dpogs mi bya'o/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i rang lugs sun phyung nas/ dus 'khor gyi bstan bcos rtsom pa ni bu ru brdzus nas rabs gcod pa'i dpe'o/ /de ltar na dpal jo nang pa'i rang lugs la nges pa rnyed nas bum sgrub kyi cho ga dngos gzhi ni dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho dngos dang*/ ngag 'don la gnyis kyi dkyus ltar yin pas gzhan rnams go sla la/ rgyud las/ a sogs ka sogs rdo rje ldan pa dag gis rang gi snying gar pad+ma zla nyi me steng du/ /zhes gsungs pa la dmigs pa rgyas pa byed na mngon byang lnga las dus 'khor bskyed pa yin yang*/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe skad cig gam sa bon las bskyed pas chog go /de yang bum pa rnams lha yab yum gnyis 'dus kyi ngo bo yin pas/ yab yum kyi thugs ka'i nyi zla kha sbyor las lcags kyu spro ba yin la/ thig skud dang dril bu lha mo'i ngo bo yin pas/ yum gyi thugs ka'i nyi ma las lcags kyu spro'o/ /rdul tshon rdo rje lha yab kyi ngo bo yin pas yab kyi thugs ka'i zla ba las lcags kyu spro ba yin zhing*/ bum pa rnams lha ji lta bu'i ngo bo zhe na/ dkyil 'khor gyi skabs nus ma bcu logs su yod pas yab rkyang du byed pa dang*/ 'dir nag po 'bar ba la sogs pa'i yab bcu la rang mtshungs kyi yum byed kyang rung ste rigs kun khyab yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ci ste na nag po 'bar ba la ser mo 'bar mas 'khyud pa sogs gzhan rigs kyi tshul du byas kyang rung mod/ de yang nag po 'bar ba'i stong gzugs de rjes dran gyi dus na lha sku yab yum du 'gyur la/ skyes bu gang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa na/ de yang ye shes kyi lha nag po 'bar ba dang nag mo 'bar mar 'gyur ro/

/de'i gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gre ste/ sems 'grel gyi dgongs pa bum pa lhag gnas kyi don 'di kho na'o/ /gzungs thag rdo rje sogs spyi 'gros kyi lag len bzhin du'ang mdzad la/ rgyud 'grel las ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang chog mod/ byed na rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan chu la shar ba dang bcas pa ni lha rnams kyi thugs rdo rje mtshon la gzungs thag gam me tog gi 'phreng pa ni/ sngags kyi 'od zer 'gro ba'i lam yin par grags pa bzhin/ rgya gar na dngos po gang dang gang la sngags bzla ba la/ bod gtsang sme med pa rnams kyi spyod pa ltar thu thu mi zer bar lam gtong pa'i srol yod pa ltar yin pas 'gal ba med la/ 'on kyang gzungs thag rdo rje btags pa na gzhan gyi mig rgyugs thebs te/ rnam rgyal chen po mchod yon gyi snod yin par bzung na ni nor tshab chen po 'ong ngo*/ /gnyis pa thig skud ni/ spyir rgyud 'di las khru nyi shu pa dang*/ bcu drug pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pa rnams la rang rang gi nyis 'gyur thig skud byas kyang 'ong*/ khru brgyad pa'i thig skud nyid bsrings te btab kyang rung la/ khru bzhi pa las chung ba'i dkyil 'khor la ni rang rang gi nyis 'gyur dang*/ sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha yin zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ khru brgyad pa'i thig skud mi dgos mod/ spyir de dag gi nang nas sku'i rtsa thig khru bzhi pa gru bzhi ni dkyil 'khor yin la/ chang zung mi the bar byas nas de nyis 'gyur gyi khru brgyad pa nyid gtso bor bsngags shing*/ bzhi 'gyur khru bcu drug pa yang gsungs nas/ lhag ma khru nyi shu las lhag ste khru stong gi bar du yang thig skud de kho nas byed de/ khru brgyad par longs pa yan chad kun la sbom phra yang slob dpon gyi nas gcig ste/ mtheb sor gyi brgyad cha yin la/ dkyil 'khor shin tu che na de nyid rim pas bsrengs te gdab pa yin no/

/gang ltar yang thig skud de ni rtsa gsum rnam par dag pas gsum sgril dang*/ mi lus khru bzhi'i tshad can la thabs shes kyi dbye ba rnam par dag pas khru brgyad dang*/ thig le bzhi dag pa'i sgo nas khru bcu drug par yang 'gyur te/ rtsa gsum gcig tu 'dres pa'i bde stong zung 'jug gam/ rdo rje bzhi mtshon no/ /gsum sgril ni/ las thams cad la spyi khyab tu nag dmar dkar ba gsum sgril du byas na legs te/ rtsa'i dag pa dang yang mthun mod/ las so so dang mthun pa'i kha dog tu byas nas/ dkar po gsum sgril sogs byas na'ang legs par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil chog gzhan gyi ye thig la kha dog lnga'i thig skud rnams lha so so dang sbyor ba 'grig par yod kyang*/ 'dir gsum sgril la yum lnga ji ltar sbyor snyam na/ 'dir zhal phyag gi rnam par mi bskyed pas dogs pa de mi 'jug ste/ sa bon lnga po yum lnga dngos yin la/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las thig skud du gyur pa'i phyir/ thig skud ril po rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma yin pa nas/ ril po spyan ma'i bar du'ang yin pa'i yum lnga char gyi gzhi mthun par mos pa yin pas dogs pa de rtsa ba nas med la/ ci ste zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du sgom na ni/ srad bu de cha lngar bgos pa'i cha re re yum re rer bsgoms pas chog ste gsum sgril dang lha lnga mi 'gal lo/ /rgyud 'grel 'dir ni ye thig dang las thig gi dbye ba ye ma gsungs shing*/ dkyil 'khor kyi thig skud ni gcig pu yin par gsungs pas rdo rje'i thig gdab pa zhes brjod kyi las dang ye shes kyi dbye ba mi bya'o/ /gsum pa rdul tshon ni rgyud las/ rdo rje sogs dang rin chen lnga dang gser dang ma ra ka ta byu ru mu tig la sogs dang*/ dbye ba lnga yi 'bru'am rnam mang nor bu dang ni de bzhin nyid du btags pa'i tshon rnams kyi/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob ma 'khor los bsgyur ba dngos yin na ma btags pa rang byung gi rdul tshon rdo rje pha lam kyi bye gseg kha dog lnga po so so dang*/

yang margad/ in+d+ra nī la/ pad+ma rā gazla ba chu shel/ karke ta na/ mthon ka chen po ste kha dog drug gi rin po che'i dngos phye mar btags pa'i rdul tshon no/ /'khor los bsgyur ba phal pas ni/ gser dang*/ mu tig dang*/ byu ru dang*/ mu men dang*/ tshon bzhi bsres pa'i ljang gu'am/ sngo ljang tshon thob nyung bas mar gad dang*/ mthon ka chen po'i rigs gyi rdos phye ma'o/ /skye bo phal pas ni/ rdo rje'i phye ma rang byung gi tshab tu ma nyam pa'i 'bras bu'i tshon te/ dper na dkar po dang*/ nag po la ti la dkar nag lta bu dang*/ 'bras kyi rigs shin tu phra ba yang mang po yod pas/ de dag kha bsgyur bas kyang rung ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor shin tu che na ni 'bru chen pos kyang rung ngo*/ /yang nor bu btags pa'i dod du 'bru'am rdo la sogs pa btags pa ste/ kha dog kyang rang byung dang bcos ma gnyis ka 'byung ngo*/ /de dag la sha khrag dri chu bshang ba khu rdul sogs kyi cha shas kyang so sor bsre dgos par gsungs pas tha na mos pa tsam yang bya dgos so/ /'dir 'khor los bsgyur ba zhes gsungs pa/ 'dul mngon las bshad pa lta bu'i gser dngul zangs lcags kyi nges bzung can min te/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yang 'di'i 'khor los bsgyur ba yin la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba phal pa ni/ bram ze rnams kyi 'dod pa ltar khams kyi rgyal po mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i don no/ /'dir rdul tshon ni kha dog drug dkar yod na/ dbus su sngon po'i steng du ljang gu bzhag shar du nag po sogs phyogs kyi rim pas bkod/ bskyed chog gi skabs su yang dbus kyi rdul tshon ljang sngo gnyis kar aṃ las byung ba'i rnam pa rdul tshon ljang sngo ngo bo me bskyod par bskyed pa sogs te gcig tu bsres ma bsres kyi khyad par gyis thig skud dang 'di mi 'dra ste/ 'dir so sor bskyed pa nges par dgos so//

//bzhi pa rdo rje lha gnas kyi skabs su/ ye shes le'u las/ nor bu gtsug tor dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga'i gnas dang lte ba gsang ba la yang rdo rje ni/ /gcig gnyis chu gter mda' dang klu yi dbang po dgu bcas nyin byed sor rnams dag gi rim pas so/ /dbus dang steng 'og gsum gyi cha ste zum pa dang ni rnam par gyais pa zhi dang drag po la'o/ /zhes dang*/ khyon ni de yi sum cha zhal dang bcas pa'i lte ba 'dab ma dag kyang de yi sum cha las/ /rwa ni khyon dang mtshungs pa phyogs sam phyogs bral du ste rwa yi zlum po dag ni bzhi cha'o/ /phyi rol rwa yi sum cha 'og ste steng du rgya shug tsher ma yi ni rnam pa sbyor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rna rgyan gyi rdo rje ni rdo rje nor bu rnam par dag pa sor gcig pa dang*/ mthe bo'i rdo rje ni gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo dag pas sor gnyis pa dang*/ skra mtshams kyi rdo rje 'phreng ba ni/ dpral pa'i 'khor lo dag pa sor bzhi pa dang*/ mgul rgyan gyi rdo rje ni/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo dag pa sor lnga pa dang*/ do shal gyi rdo rje ni snying ga'i 'khor lo dag pa sor brgyad pa dang*/ snying gar 'dogs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba srung ba dang bsnyen pa'i don du dgos te/ de ni lte ba'i 'khor lo dag pas sor dgu pa'o/ /gsor pa'i rdo rje ni gsang pa'i 'khor lo dag pa ste sor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ 'dir gsor pa'i rdo rje ste/ de yang dkyus su sor bcu gnyis/ de la cha gsum du byas pa'i cha tha ma gnyis ni steng 'og gi dbus rwa'i dkyus yin la/ cha dbus ma la yang cha gsum du byas te steng 'og gnyis ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi sa dang*/ dbus ma lte ba'i sa ste 'di la thig le bzhi thabs kyi cha rnam par dag pa dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi rnam par dag pa'i dbang du byas nas/ phyogs bzhir gzugs pa'i zhal bzhi bya zhing*/ yang na rdo rje ni gsal byed sum cu dag pa'i dbang du byas na/

dbyangs med pas brjod mi shes pa'i phyir zhal med pa'i zlum po'o/ /rdo rje dbus kyi rwa'i dkyus ni sor bzhi yin la/ de la cha gsum du btang pa'i 'og tu sum cha gcig dang*/ steng du sum cha gnyis yod pa'i mtshams de ni rwa'i sbom sa ste/ de'i zhing la sor gcig gi rgya'o/ /de las 'og tu zhu 'drongs kyi 'phrar song zhing*/ steng du zhu 'drongs kyi lhag par phra zhing rtse mo rno ba yin la/ dbus kyi rwa gru bzhi dang phyogs kyi rwa rnams cung zad zlum pa dbus rwa las cung zad phra ba'o/ /rwa lnga pa'am dgu pa gang yin yang rung ste/ g.yas g.yon gyi rwa rnams kyang brkyang na dbus rwa dang ring thung mnyam pa yin yang rked mtshams nas gzhu ltar gug pa'i phyir/ rtse mo dbus rwa las dkyus las thung ba ste/ zhi ba la ni/ phyogs kyi rwa'i rtse rnams dbus kyi rwa la reg pas sor phyed tsam dbus kyi rwa phyir 'phags pa yin la/ drag po la ni kha gyes pa yin yang*/ bar gyi cha sor phyed bzhi tsam zhi ba las tshabs che tsam gug cing*/ sor phyed tsam steng du rtse mo rnon po'i rnam pa ste/ phyogs rnams gug pa'i khyad kyis mtha' rnams las dbus rwa sor byed tsam 'phags pa yin/ de yang pad+ma'i kha mtshams las 'phred du nas gang tsam re nang du gzhal ba'i mtshams nas phyogs kyi rwa rnams skyes te/ sor phyed tsam drang por 'phags nas sor gang tsam phyir sogs 'gros dang*/ de mtshams nas gzhu ltar gug pa'i sgur phyi la bstan pa yin pa/ rwa de rnams kyi phyed dam sum gnyis mtshams tsam gang rung la sbom sa 'ong ba byed de bzo'i khyad par las so/ /sbom sa'i thad la brtsis na shar gyi rwa mtha' nas nub kyi rwa mtha'i bar la'ang sor bzhi yod la/ de khor yug tu zlum por bcal na sor bcu gnyis te rdo rje dkyus dang mnyam pa'o/ /zla ba'i steng du mu tig gi 'phreng ba sogs dang*/ chu srin gyi gdong sogs rgyud 'dir ma gsungs pa'i phyir nges par dgos pa ma yin la/

spyi 'gros su snang bas byas kyang 'gal ba med par mngon no/ /de ltar tshad dang ldan pa rgyu ni gser dngul zangs sogs dang*/ phur bu'i rgyur bshad pa rnams kyang rung bas ji ltar 'os pa'o/ /'dir yang ngo bo hūm̐ las byung ba gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo nyid rnam pa rdo rje nyid du shar ba'o/ /lnga pa dril bu lhag gnas kyi skabs su/ rgyud las/ dril bu dag kyang de bzhin cha gsum steng ni rdo rje dang mtshungs ba lang gdong dang pad+ma'i gzugs/ /zhes dang*/ dril bu'i zhal rnams de bzhin 'dab ma rdo rje yang ngo ba lang gdong la sogs pa de bzhin nyid/ /ces kyang gsungs te/ 'dir rdo rje dril bu zhes pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu'o/ /dril bu de dpangs su sor bcu gnyis pa ste/ de yang steng 'og tu cha gsum du byas pa'i cha gcig steng ma ni rdo rje phyed pa/ cha bar pa ni zhal gyi gnas cha 'og ma ni lto ba ste de la rdo rje phyed pa'i tha snyad ni rwa rnams la 'jug ste gong dang 'dra'o/ /dbus kyi cha la cha gsum du byas pa'i steng 'og gnyis pad+ma dang dbus ma la gzhal te de yang thig le bzhi'i nang nas shes rab kyi phyogs dang*/ rnam thar sgo bzhi dag pas zhal bzhi dang*/ yang na dril bu ā li rnam par dag pa chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i phyir zhal gcig pa ste/ de yang rdo rje zhal bzhi dang ldan pa la dril bu yang zhal bzhi pa dang*/ rdo rje la zhal med na ni/ dril bu zhal gcig pa'o/ /rdo rje dang dril bu rigs gnyis ka la'ang zhi drag gnyis ka 'byung bas/ rdo rje rigs bzhi dang dril bu rigs bzhi dang*/ de la'ang rtse dgu rtse lnga'i dbye bas brgyad dam rwa'i dbye bas sna tshogs pa'o/ /dril bu'i khog pa'i skra mtshams kyi rgya dang*/ rdo rje byed pa'i rwa'i sboms gnyis rgya mnyam pa dang*/ de nas sor gsum du cung zad zhu 'drongs dang bcas pas kha je rgyas las/ zhi ba la ni ba lang kha ste mtshams de nas dpangs su sor phyed tsam gyi tshad phyi la nas gnyis tsam 'phags nas/

de nas kha'i mtha' sor phyed nang du nas gang tsam rub pa yin la/ de ltar ba lang kha la rtse mor zhi pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa yin/ yang na pad+ma rgyas pa'i kha ste/ khog pa sor gsum gyi bar gong bzhin la/ de nas dpangs su sor gcig po rgyar sor phyed kyi bar du sngar bas kyang je rgyas su song zhing*/ kha rgyun cung zad 'thug par bya ste/ nang du zhum pa ni med do/ /'di la rdo rje rā gyes pas mtshan pa'o/ /rdo rje dang dril bu gnyis kar la rwa la zhi drag gi dbye ba yod pas zhal ras la'ang zhi drag dgos par sems/ dril bu la bzo thig cung zad kyang rung pa steng gi rwa la rtse sor bzhi tsam byas nas/ bar gyi cha steng ma pad+ma bar pa zhal ras/ 'og ma la pad+ma'i 'og tu dbyug pa rtse sor phyed tsam bla thabs su bsnan/ lhag po rtse sor gang tsam pa de ni 'og gi khog pa'i dpangs la bsnan nas khog pa dngos la sor bzhi dang thod dpangs rtse sor gcig bya/ de'i tshe khog pa'i skra mtshams la mu khyud yod pa'i nang mtha' dang*/ rdo rje'i rwa'i sboms kyi phyi mtha' mnyam pa tsam byas na gzhung dang yang mi 'gal la mdzes pa'i phyir 'di la mi legs pa med do/ /'dir dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho las/ zhi ba la ba lang gi gdong lta bu rdo rje'i kha zum pas mtshan pa dang*/ drag po la pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu rdo rje/ kha gyes pas mtshan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don khog pa ba lang kha dang pad+ma kha yin pa la/ steng du kha gyes pa dang zum pas mtshan pa zhes pa'i don du thams cad kyis go nus par 'dug kyang*/ spyan snga chos grags pa ni go ba log ste ba lang gdong gi don rdo rje kha zum pa dang*/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i don kha gyes pa la kun mkhyen chen po bzhed do zhes yi ger 'dri ba ni/ gzhan la skyon rtog gyu'i khungs la hal hol du smras pas rang nyid la gzhan dag bzhad gad kyi rgyu chen po byung ba'o/ /'grel pa las/ ba lang gi gdong ni zhi ba la'o/

/zhes pa'i dol mchan du/ dril bu'i kha rgyun nang du rub pa zhes dang*/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i kha zhes pa'i dol mchan du dril bu'i kha rgyun phyir gyed pa zhes 'byung ba'ang mthong bar gyur cig dril bu yang gong bzhin rnam pa dril bu nyid la sna tshogs yum gyi ngo bo nyid du bsam dgos pa yin no/ /gzhan rdzas lnga sta gon gyi skabs rnams/ dkyil chog nyid kyis go bla'o/ /gsum pa slob ma lhag gnas ni/ rdzas lnga lhag gnas kyi gnas de nyid du byed pa yin na/ rdzas rnams gzhan du bsdus te/ slar mal stan lhag gnas kyi tshe dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la sngar bzhin 'jog par bshad pa ltar yin yang yol bas bcad pa'am/ khebs kyis bkab kyang rung ste dgos don mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa las gzhan du yin na dgag bya med pas/ rdzas rnams bsdu mi dgos te ji ltar rigs par spyad do/ /rgyud 'grel nyid las gsungs pa'i slob ma lhag gnas dngos ni/ so shing dor ba dang*/ yi ge drug pas srung ba dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' bskul ba ste chos gsum po de tsam yin la/ sngon du gsol btab dang*/ snod du rung ba'i phyir chos bshad pa rgyud 'di nyid las 'byung ba ci rigs sbyar na'ang legs pas dus 'khor rang lugs kho na byed 'dod pa dang*/ slob ma'ang de tsam la yid ches na/ de tsam gyis skyon kun spangs yon tan kun rdzogs kyi sta gon yin mod/ spros pa la dga' ba rnams kyi ngor gsang ba spyi'i cho gas kha bskang pa ni dkyil chog tu bshad zin pa ltar yin pa/ 'di'i lugs la dpyad na/ rgya gar ba blos btags mkhan po dang*/ bod mang po zhig gsang ba nor thig las 'byung ba'i sdom bzung gi gung la yod pa'i rigs lnga'i skor rnams phud nas/ dus 'khor gyi rigs drug sdom bzung 'jug pa dag mthong ste/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ zhes sogs dang ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /zhes sogs rgyud 'dir byang chub bdag gis bskyed ces pa'i nang du 'dus pa ma go bas de dag byed mod/

phan tshun bsres pas gnyis yin du ma song gnyis min du song ba'i don gyi sgo nas 'khrul bar ma zad/ kha skong byed pa'i skabs su/ sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /zhes pa'i tshig don gnyid kar sgrig mtshams ma shes nas 'jog pa sogs rkang dum re 'dren par byed do/ kha cig rigs lnga'am drug gi sdom bzung lan gsum byas pas sngags sdom rdzogs par thob par 'dod pa la ni/ sta gon gyi skabs kho nar sngags sdom rdzogs par thob zin pa'i skyon 'jug go /gzhan rnams go bla zhing*/ dkyil chog spyi'i go don zhig 'bri bar 'dod pas 'dir ma bshad do/ /rang re'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la gong du bshad pa'i dus 'khor rang lugs kyi sta gon de tsam re/ bdag 'jug la yang mdzad par snang ba/ sgrub mchod la yang lhag gnas brgyad ka tshang bar dgos par bzhed de 'grub na de bzhin du bya'o/ /bzhi pa mal lhag gnas ni/ rdzas lnga phyogs ma 'chol bar yod pa'i ngang der/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa cha'i lho phyogs su mal stan bcas shing*/ oṃ hoḥsogs kyi sngags mang du bzlas nas/ mgo nub dang rkang pa shar du bstan te/ slob dpon rang nyid seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal ba na/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i ltas rmi lam du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas byang sems lha lha mo dgyes shing rtse ba dang*/ rdo rje khro bo dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bdud bgegs 'joms pa'i mtshan ma sogs mthong na shin tu legs shing ci yang ma mthong na 'bring yin pas/ de gnyis la ni de'i nangs par nyid nas thig gdab cing dkyil 'khor 'bri'o/ /ci ste bdud bgegs kyi rigs mngon gsal can rnams/ cho 'phrul gyi rigs mthong zhing*/ logs pa'i skye bo la gnod pa'i rnam 'gyur byed pa dang*/ gzhan yang ngan par mngon na/ slob dpon gyi mal stan spangs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i shar du 'dug nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma sbyin zhing*/

dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la 'dug nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ bgegs zhi bar gsol pa btab bo/ 'di ni mtshon byed de/ srung ma drug cu dang*/ rigs brgya rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs la yang 'grub na gtor ma 'bul lo/ /de'i rjes su rdo rje'i zhal dag pa nas brtsams te/ srung 'khor yang rdzogs par bsgoms la/ tshogs bsags gnyis sngon du 'gro bas mngon byang lnga bskyed dam sa bon phyag mtshan tsam las/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed sdom pa chen por bsgom/ de ma thag rgyan dang phyag mtshan bkod kyang rung la/ yang na ye shes pa spyan drangs/ yi ge bkod/ rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs/ sngags dbang rdzogs par blangs/ rgyas btab bzhi'i mthar phyag mtshan rgyan bkod byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de'i tshe rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa drag tu bzla zhing*/ sngags don dang mthun par bgegs gzhom pa'i dmigs pa yang bya/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sngags kyang nges par bzla bar bya ste/ snying po'i mthar/ a ā aṃ aḥ ha hā haṃ haḥ phreṃ hoḥ ha hā hi hī

hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄/ sl̥ sl̥̄ shi shī haṃ haḥhuṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ āḥ thu thū'u dhi dhī la lā huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ p+li p+lī phu phū bhi bhī wa wā huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ṭhu ṭhū ḍhi ḍhī ra rā huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ tshu tshū dzhi dzhī ya yā huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ kl̥ kl̥̄ khu khū ghi ghī ha hā huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣā nga ngā ༵༵༵ྈྐ na nā ma mā ṇa ṇā nya nyā huṃ hūṃ phreṃ phraiṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /sngags 'di ni drag po'i las dang bgegs tshar gcod pa la bsngags pa'o/ /de'i nub mo yang sngar bzhin mal stan lhag gnas kyis brtag bgegs bzlog pa'i mtshan ma byung na legs/ ma byung na sngar bzhin yang yang gtor ma dang bzlas bsgom bya/ nam bgegs bzlog pa'i mtshan ma byung ba na/ nang bar gtor ma rgya cher btang ste/ sngar gyi la dga' ston dang phyin chad mi 'jug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ de nas de ma thag tu thig gdab par bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa thig tshon gyi las kyis dkyil 'khor bzheng pa ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu gnas nas kha shar du phyogs shing*/ zhes pa nas nyi ma gsum pa'i bya ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thig 'debs tshul bstan la/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la zhes pa nas/ nyi ma bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i bya ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis tshon gyis 'bri ba'i rim pa bshad de/ 'di dag rgyas par rgyud 'grel nyid las 'byung zhing*/ phal cher go bde bar yang yod la/ rgyud dang 'grel pa gnyis su gsungs pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa shin tu gsal bar dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho dang*/ bden pa gnyis kyi tshon sa gtan la dbab pa zhes bya bar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen chen po nyid kyis zhib mor gsungs pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /de la dbye na/ thig gdab pa dang*/ rdul tshon dbyai ba'o/ /dang po la thig chog dngos la dpyad pa/ thig cha la bshad pa/ yongs 'joms bshad pa/

dag pa bshad pa/ rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba/ rjes kyi bya ba bshad pa ste drug go /dang po ni/ rdzas lnga po rnams dben pa'i gnas su stan dri ma med pa la bzhag ras gtsang mas bkab cing sngags kyis srung ngo*/ / sā dhu pu tras ni/ spyi'i rigs 'gros sbyar nas ye thig gi rjes su las thig 'debs/ 'bro ba kha cig dang rwa pa yang de dang 'dra/ gzhan dag ni de gnyis snga phyi bsgyur ba tsam byed cing*/ gzhan yang so so la nang sel 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba ji snyed zhig yod kyang*/ dkyil chog gzhan gyi lugs kyi thig chog de 'dir sbyor ba snying po med de/ 'di nyid du thig skud byin rlabs kyi sngags dang thig gdab pa'i sngags thun mong ma yon pa'i rgyas pa 'di 'dra yod bzhin du/ oṃ āḥ.a mṛ ta bhā badz+ra sū tra zhes sogs bcos ma'i sngags kyi snon ka la dga' ba ni/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis snang bar byed bzhin pa la/ me khyer tshol ba rgyug pa bzhin no/ /kha cig thig skud sum sgril dngos su gsungs la/ byin rlabs kyi sngags la yum lnga'i sa bon yod pas lnga sgril gcig kyang bstan par 'gyur bas/ las yi gnyis kar dgos te/ sum sgril ye thig dang lnga sgril las thig go zer ba dang*/ lhag gnas kyi thig skud la kha cig las thig yin/ gzhan dag ye thig yin zer ba dang*/ byams gling pa ni thig 'debs pa'i sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes rdo rje gsum gyi sa bon yod pas thig 'debs pa'i tshe rdo rje gsum du bskyed dgos zer te/ de thams cad 'grel chen du thig skud gnyis pa med par bshad pa dang 'gal/ rdo rje gsum du skyed zer ba ni yum lnga'i ngo bor gsungs pa dang 'gal/ rdo rje gsum gyi sa bon yod pas de bskyed dgos na/ thig skud brkyang pa'i sngags kyi gzhugs na/ yum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon yod cing*/ thig skud gdab pa'i sngags la rigs drug gi sa bon yang yod pas/

de dag kyang sgom dgos par thal bar 'gyur la/ 'dod tshul sna tshogs pa de dag la 'gog byed mang mod kyi/ log pa'i lan la mtha' med pa'i dper shes nas 'dir ma bris so/ /gnyis pa ni/ skabs 'dir thig cha la ni zhi rgyas la tsan+dan dkar po'i lde gu'am/ 'bras btags pa sogs dkar pos bya la/ bsad bskrad la dug khrag dang ro sol bsres pa dang*/ dbang dgug la gur gum dang tsan+dan dmar po bsres pa dang*/ rmongs rengs la yung ba dang tsan+dan dmar po dang bab la'i khu bas so/ /gsum pa ni yongs 'joms spong pa zhes bya ba ni/ shar lho nas nub byang du btab pa'i zur thig la tshad bzhag lho lho nub/ nub nub byang thig skud de'i lho'i dum bu shes rab kyi sa phyogs su slob dpon thabs bgrod cing*/ thig skud de'i byang gi sa'i dum bu/ byang byang shar shar shar lho/ thabs kyi sa gzhi la slob ma shes rab bgrod par byed do/ /de las zlog na mi shes te/ phyi rol tu me rlung gi mtshams gang rung du sgra gcan gyi gdong mjug gnas pas g.yul du 'jug pa rnams de la 'gongs na/ gzhan gyis 'joms pa ltar 'dir yang de las 'gongs na/ slob dpon nam slob ma la gnod pa chen po 'byung bas yongs 'joms zhes btags so/ /'dir rgyud las/ shes rab thabs kyi yan lag dbus su yongs 'joms su 'gyur de ni dkyil 'khor dag la spang bar bya/ / zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang thig skud chad par gyur na bla ma nyam zhing yongs 'joms 'gongs par gyur na bu rnams dag kyang ngo zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni skabs 'dir dag pa'i rnam grangs cig la sgrub thabs kyi skabs su bshad pa 'di yang go bar bya ste/ khru gcig 'jig rten khams kyi dpag tshad 'bum phrag re dang sbyor/ khru gcig ni sgo tshad gcig yin no/ /de la sa'i dkyil 'khor sgo tshad phyed/ phyi rol du sa dkyil gyi zhing la dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga dang sbyor/ chu me rlung gsum la sgo tshad re re yod pa/

phyi rol tu yang 'bum phrag phyed phyed kyi zhing yod pa dang sbyor/ phyi rol kyi nam mkha'i brgya stong phrag nyer lnga la rdzogs pa min yang nam mkha'i khams phra ba mtshon byed du dkyil 'khor la sgo tshad phyed mar byas pas khor yug lnga'i zhing du khru gnyis yod la/ sa'i khor yug gi nang nas sku'i rtsa thig gi bar la'ang khru gnyis/ de nas gtso bo'i gnas kyi tshangs thig la'ang khru gnyis te/ phyogs gcig la khru drug dang cig shos la'ang de dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor khru bcu gnyis ni bden don bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa dang*/ yang thig skud khru bcu drug pa'am/ sgo tshad khru phyed dang sbyar na khru phyed bcu drug sgo tshad bcu drug pa ni de nyid rnam pa bcu drug gi dag par yang bya la/ yang gcig tu na/ thig skud kyi tshad de deng sang gi mthong cha ltar na/ myos srung gong ma'i thad yin yang sgom don la mchod pa'i sa gzhi dang sa'i khor yug gi mtshams yin zhing*/ de la khru brgyad yod pa yin la/ de'i phyi rol tu sa dang nam mkha'i khor yug sgo tshad re re/ chu me rlung gsum sgo tshad gnyis gnyis te/ dkyus las lnga pa 'gyur du spar bas phyogs re'i khor yug lnga la khru bzhi bzhi ste/ phyogs gnyis bsdoms pas brgyad 'byung la/ de dang thig skud kyi dkyus bsdoms pas khru bcu drug ni/ de nyid bcu drug gi dag pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /lnga pa ni/ yang rgyud 'grel las/ spros bcas spros med kyi thig gnyis gsungs te/ dang po ni/ sor dang sor phyed kyi grangs las gzhal te zhib rtsis phra mo mdzad pa yin pas cung zad go dka' la/ phyi ma ni cha che chung gzhal nas rags rtsis su mdzad pas go bde ste/ che chung phra sbom gyi tshad la mi 'dra ba ni med mod/ da lta'i thig rtsa yang spros med nyid la gzhi blangs pa'o/ /de ltar yang bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las dbang gi le'ur/ thig ni ro dang dgu bcu 'di rnams tshangs pa'i thig las phyogs kyi cha rnams dag tu rab sbyin bya/

zhes pa nas/ nyi ma dag gi sgo yi dbus dang mkha' dang sa gzhi dag la shar gyi cha dang nub la yang*/ /zhes pa'i bar du sho lo ka drug ste/ dbang le'i tshigs bcad so lnga pa la sogs pa yin na/ de'i skabs kyi 'grel chen yang*/ dbang le'i mdor bsdus gsum pa'i thog ma/ gnas skabs 'dir sngar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sa la nub tu zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa'o zhes pa'i bar du/ bsdus rgyud kyi 'bru mnan pas spros bcas kyi thig gtso bor bshad cing*/ rtsa rgyud las/ gru bzhi mnyam pa'i sa dag la/ /bcu drug cha ru byas nas ni/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor dor bya ste/ /slar yang cha ni bcu drug pa/ /gsung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bya/ /de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor dag /dor nas cha ni bcu drug pa/ /slar yang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bya/ /de ltar phyogs gsum yang dag dag /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bdag nyid do/ /de nas gnyis dang chu sogs chas/ /dkyil 'khor gsum de thig gdab po/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bsdus rgyud las kyang*/ gnyis dang chu gter gcig dang chu gter gcig nyi dus ro rtse mo can me dus phyed dus phyed dang*/ dus dang dus ni rab phye dag dang dus dang ro dag kyang ste skyon gyi cha rnams rim pa yis/ /snying por lte ba'i phyed dang chu skyes 'dab ma yang ste de nas ka ba rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang*/ /pad+ma rdo rje'i 'phreng bar 'gyur te sa dag dang ni de nas sgo dang sgo mkhyud la sogs dang*/ /ka ba rwa ba stegs bu dag dang slar yang de nas snam bu dang ni do shal sa dag dang/ /me long sa yi rnam bu rta babs dag tu mi yi bdag po rab tu brjod pa'i cha yis 'gyur/ /phyi rol du ni sgo sogs thams cad nyis 'gyur tu 'gyur phyi rol tu yang de yi nyis 'gyur ro/ /phyi rol tu ni pad+ma 'khor lo shing rta rnams dang dkyil 'khor rnams ni nyin byed dag gis so/ /zhes pas spros med kyi thig bstan te/

'di gnyis la thig 'debs tshul so so ba byas kyang rung mod/ 'on kyang spros bcas go yul du nges par byas nas lag len du spros med ltar 'debs pa nyid dgongs pa yang yin te/ 'grel chen las thig gang zhig dbye bar bya ba de dag ni gdab par bya ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa/ spyi babs spros med kyi skabs su dgongs pa yin yang*/ shugs la dbye dgos pa bas dbye mi dgos pa'i phyogs legs par bstan pa'ang yin no/ /thig gi skabs 'dir 'grel chen las/ sangs rgyas dang lha mo rnams kyi bar gyi le tshe rnams la bum pa'am thod pa rnams gyi gdan brgyad du 'gyur te/ zhes gsungs pas/ kha cig 'dod pa ltar gyi rgyal ba rigs bzhi'i re mig la bum thod 'god pa shin tu bkag go /drug pa ni 'grel chen las/ de nas dri dang spos la sogs pa phul nas/ dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i thig rnams yang dag par bsrungs te/ lhag ma thams cad dbye bar bya'o/ /sgo thams cad yang dag par sbyangs te/ slar yang dri dang me tog la sogs pa dang*/ gtor ma byin nas sngar brjod pa'i cho gas sngags bzlas par bya'o zhes/ dbang le'i mdor bsdus gnyis pa'i 'jug tu gsungs so/ /'di ni kha cig sa la btab pa'i thig la mchod nas/ de rjes thig ro rnams phyis/ sgo'i thad kyi rtsa thig kyang sbyangs te/ slar yang sa mthil la gnas pa'i thig la mchod gtor 'bul zhes pa'i don du 'dod pa dang*/ phyi ma 'di thig skud la mchod gtor 'bul bar 'dod pa sogs yod kyang*/ don la gnas pa'i phyogs ni/ thig gdab zin pa'i rjes su thig skud la mchod pa phul/ sgo'i rtsa thig sbyangs nas bar chad mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ mkha' 'gro ma dang srung ma drug cu la mchod gtor phul nas rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgoms pa'i cho gas sngags bzla ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdul tshon bri pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba cung zad brjod de/ rdul tshon gyi cho ga la dpyad pa/

tshon thob dang lha mtshan bshad pa/ 'phros don dogs spong thor bu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dang rdul tshon la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ sa'i lha mo la gtor ma'ang phul/ lhag gnas byas pa'i rdul tshon rnams blangs te/ thog mar slob dpon gyi khu tshur g.yon pas/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du 'gyed la/ de ma thag nas las kyi slob ma rnams kyis ji ltar 'os par dgye'o/ /de la 'di ni chos nyid dag pa ste sogs kyang brjod pa phyag len la mdzad de/ gzhan gyis kha skongs yin yang 'gal ba med do/ /snga rabs pa rnams tshon bkra brtags pa la phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams khungs med ces 'gog kyang*/ tshad dang ldan pa'i gzhung las bkag pa med cing*/ 'gal bar ma gyur phyin chad man ngag gi lag len thor bur byung ba rnams la re re nas khungs gsal med kyang dgag tu mi btub ste/ bu ston dang rdo rje dpal ba'i dpe bzhin no/ /slob dpon sman pa zhabs dang dam tshig rdo rjes dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa snod kyis 'gebs par bshad pas/ tshon bkra brtags pa'ang de'i lag len du gsal te/ des na khungs med pa'ang min la/ 'on kyang tshon bkra brtags pa 'dir mi 'chad do/ /rtsig pa rnams la rwa ba'i bar stongs zhes bya ba/ rdul tshon gyi rtse mo'i bar stongs yin te/ rtsa ba ni reg la ma 'dres pa dgos kyi sa stongs yod par 'dod pa mi legs so/ /de yang thugs dkyil la rtsig pa'i sa gzhi cha dgur btang ba'i cha gnyis gnyis rwa ba'i sa zhes grags la zhib mor na rwa ba gsum la bar stongs gnyis las med pas/ bar stongs gnyis la cha re re dang*/ rwa ba re re la cha gnyis sum cha re'o/ /de bzhin du gsung dang sku la'ang rtsig pa'i zhing cha bco lnga rer btang ba'i ra ba re la gnyis re dang*/ bar stongs re la cha re'o zhes rags rtsis la 'jog kyang*/ bar stongs bzhi las med pa'i cha gcig po de rwa ba la bsnan no/

/'on kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams phra mo tsam yin pas gnad chung ngo*/ /thig skud yum lnga'i ngo bo yin pas/ thig rjes kyang yum lnga'i rang bzhin yin la/ de'i steng du rdul tshon yab lnga'i rang bzhin bkrams pas/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi dag par 'gyur ba yin no/ /phyis kyi phal cher zhig rdzas lnga'i skabs kyi de lhag gnas zhes pas sta gon tsam yin gyi/ thig tshon byin rlabs dngos phyis byed dgos snyam pa snang ste/ lhag gnas kyi don byin rlabs sam rab gnas yin pa ma go zhing dkyil chog tshad ldan thams cad la bum pa lhag gnas las gzhan pa'i bum sgrub dngos gzhi byed rgyu med pa de phal cher ne tso'i 'don pa ltar song nas/ don la gzhug pa ma chug par lhag gnas yin pa'i phyir sta gon yin la/ de'i phyir sngon 'gro yin pas thig tshon byin rlabs dngos de gzod bya dgos snyam nas/ byin rlabs dngos gzhi dus 'khor gyi rang lugs rnam dag de sngon 'gror bzung nas 'gangs chung bar byas/ gzhan la g.yar ba'i 'dres ma cho ga ma dag pa de dngos gzhi gal po cher bzung nas/ byin rlabs lan gnyis byed pa ni blun rtags chen por snang la/ des na thig tshon sta gon ni/ thig tshon byin rlabs slar byed rgyu'i sta gon ma yin/ byin rlabs dngos gzhi yin/ thig 'debs pa dang tshon 'gyed pa'i sta gon yin pas sta gon zhes byas pa ma go ba'o/ /dper na/ bum pa sta gon de bum sgrub dngos gzhi yin yang*/ slob ma la chu dbang bskur ba'i sta gon yin pas sta gon du bzhag pa bzhin no/ /sta gon gyi don ni grabs yul byed pa yin te/ dper na/ ral gri legs par 'dus byas pa dang*/ de'i 'khrul 'khor byang bar slob pa ni/ gal che shos byin rlabs kyi dpe yin la/ gri skor gyis shing sdong gcod pa ni/ rgya lam zhig na las la sbyor ba'i dpe yin te/ gzhan rnams dag gi lugs ltar na/ 'khrul 'khor byang ba gal chung la/

sdong po gcod khar mtshon cha skor pa dngos gzhi gal po che'o zer ba dang 'dra la/ de 'dra byin rlabs lan gnyis byas pa'i phyir/ sta gon lan gnyis su 'gyur gyi/ byin rlabs phyi ma dngos gzhi ma yin te/ 'di skabs rang gi dngos gzhi thig gdab pa dang tshon 'gyed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang byin rlabs brtsegs pa bzang snyam na/ gcig tu na de ltar gyur pas legs par re yang*/ gnyis su na snga ma thob thang can dang phyi ma rtog pas sbyar ba nyid kyi phyir/ cho ga phyi mas snga ma nyam par byed pa'ang srid pas/ don med chen po bskyed nyen yod do// //gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i tshon rnams sgrub thabs su bstan pa nyid kyis go bla mod kyang*/ blo dman rnams gang la'ang brdugs par 'gyur ba mthong bas/ sdom du brjod na/ dbus kyi gtso bo'i gzhi tshon sngon po la/ /gdan gyi pad+ma ljang gu 'dab brgyad pa'i/ /lte bar nyi zla sgra gcan brtsegs pa ni/ /zlum po nag po mu khyud dmar dang dkar/ /rdo rje'i 'phreng ba zhes grags gdung yin te/ /gtso bo'i gnas kyi phyi mthar nag po dang*/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma'i phyi mthar ljang gu yin/ /gdung gnyis bar gyi ka ba bcu drug nag /ka bar re mig bcu drug sngo'am ljang*/ /yang na phyogs kyi mdog can nyid du bya/ /deng sang lag len phyi ma gtso bor mdzad/ /de yi phyi rol thugs gsung sku gsum la/ /re re bzhin yang rim pa dgu dgu ste/ /rtsig pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams phyi nang 'dra/ /tshon sa phyogs mdog lha rnams ku mud mtshungs/ / spangs chung phyogs mdog rtsig pa so sor yod/ /stegs bu dkar zhing pha gu gzhi dmar ba/ /phra rgyan ji ltar mdzes pas brgyan pa dang*/ /dra phyed shar bu mda' yab dkar po ste/ /'og gi gzhi tshon sngon po'am yang na nag /rgyan gyi rnam 'gyur phra mo nges pa med/ /lha snam gsum la gzhi tshon phyogs mdog gi /steng du dkar po shin tu 'thug par dgram/

/thog mar bcad btang de rjes bkram na bzang*/ /rta babs ka gdung gser gyi mdog can te/ /re mig rnams dang har mi mdzes tshon yin/ /dbus ma ljang na g.yas g.yon dmar ba yin/ /dbus ma dmar na g.yas g.yon sngo ba dang*/ /dbus ma dmar ser g.yas g.yon ljang ba sogs/ /har mi ser po'i yang na ljang dang sngo/ /phyogs bzhi rnams ni phan tshun mtshungs pa legs/ /bum tog gser gyi mdog can nyid du nges/ /thugs dkyil rtsig pa nang nas nag dmar dkar/ /gsung dang sku'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga/ /nang nas ljang nag dmar dkar ser po 'gyed/ /mchod pa'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can te/ /phyogs mdog ces pa zur thig bzhi po la/ /sa mtshams bcol nas shar nag lho dmar dang*/ /nub ser byang phyogs dkar po go bar bya/ /khor yug dang po ser la gnyis pa dkar/ /gsum pa dmar zhing bzhi pa bung ba'i mdog /lnga pa'i zhing du cha gsum bgos pa yi/ /phyi nang ljang gu bar ma sngon po la/ /rdo rje 'phreng rgyugs sbom por bri bar bya/ /phyi rol 'od zer 'phreng ba khra bo spel/ /ljang nag dmar dkar ser dang sngon po yin/ /lha yi gdan dang mtshan ma bshad bya ste/ /dbus kyi gtso bo'i gdan la rdo rje sngo/ /yum gyi phyag mtshan logs su 'bri ba med/ /'dab brgyad phyogs bzhir phyogs mdor spos phor dang*/ /mar me dung chos zhal zas g.yas skor yin/ /mtshams la shar lhor rnga yab nag po sogs/ /dmar ser dkar po rnams kyang g.yas skor bya/ /gru chad bzhi la dung dkar gaṇ+ḍi dmar/ /nor bu mthing kha ljon shing ser po rnams/ /byang shar mtshams nas g.yas skor nyid du bri/ /bum pa brgyad ni dkar po pad gdan dkar/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma'i re mig brgyad po la/ /phyogs bzhir pad+ma dkar dang nyi ma'i gdan/ /mtshams bzhir pad+ma dmar dang zla ba'i gdan/ /shar dang me ru ral gri nag po dang*/ /lho dang bden bral rin chen dmar po dang*/ /nub dang rlung du 'khor lo ser po dang*/

/byang dang byang shar chu skyes dkar po ste/ /yang na mtshams bzhir me nas g.yas skor gyi/ /ut+pal sngo dang pad+ma dmar po dang*/ /'khor lo ser dang ut+pal dkar po 'bri/ /lha snam shar dang lho yi g.yas g.yon dang*/ /byang gi shar dang nub kyi byang ngos dang*/ /dbang po nor sbyin phyogs kyi sgo rnams su/ /pad dkar zla ba'i gdan te mtshams bzhi dang*/ /byang gi nub dang nub kyi lho phyogs dang*/ /lho dang nub sgor pad dmar zla ba'i gdan/ /phyogs bzhi'i g.yas su ral gri la sogs bzhi/ /mtshams bzhi me sogs de dang 'dra ba'am/ /yang na na bza' ro mchog snod dmar dang*/ /dri yi dung dang me long dkar po'o/ /lho yi g.yon dang nub kyi'ang g.yon dag tu/ /rdo rje ljang gu re re dgod par bya/ /shar dang byang gi g.yon du rdo rje sngo/ /yang na nub kyi g.yon du chos 'byung ljang*/ /byang gi g.yon du pi waṃ sngon po bya/ /shar sgor ral gri nag dang lho yi sgor/ /dbyug pa dmar dang nub sgor tho ba ser/ /byang sgor pad+ma dkar po dgod pa nyid/ /steng 'og bum pa 'god na'ang shar nub kyi/ /khro bo'i mtshan mo'i phyi rol 'god pa yin/ /thugs kyi rta babs ka ba'i g.yas g.yon nang*/ /stegs bu'i steng du gzungs ma'i mtshan ma dgod/ /shar du dung chos me tog 'phreng ba dang*/ /lho ru spos phor mar me'i kong bu dang*/ /nub tu dbu rgyan rin chen do shal dang*/ /byang du zhal zas snod dang shing 'bras so/ /rta babs brtsegs ma gsum pa'i dbus gnas la/ /shar du na bza' nub tu rdza rnga dang*/ /byang du rdo rje lho ru pad+ma'o/ /gsung 'khor pad+ma rnams la g.yas skor gyi/ /gri gug nag dang 'khor lo nag po dang*/ /dbyug pa dang ni shal ti dmar po dang*/ /gser gyi mdog can rdo rje par bu dang*/ /zla 'od dang mtshungs rtse gsum pad sdong dkar/ /re re bzhin yang mtshan ma dgu dgu ste/ /so so'i lte ba dang ni 'dab brgyad la'o/

/zhor byung yin phyir yab gyi mtshan ma ni/ /nges par dgos pa ma yin 'on kyang ni/ /byed par 'dod na shar du rdo rje ser/ /de sogs g.yas skor bya ste ser po'i khab/ /tri shu la dang dgra sta dkar po dang*/ /ral gri 'bar dang 'khor lo nag po dang*/ /kha dog dmar ba'i dbyug pa shak+ti'o/ /gtso mo'i mtshan ma dbus su bkod nas ni/ /de de'i g.yas su yab kyi mtshan ma bya/ /sku dkyil tshes kyi lha yi pad+ma la/ /lte bar gnyis dang 'dab mar re re ste/ /mtshan ma sum cu 'god par bya ba las/ /thams cad phyag mtshan ngo bo'i dbyibs gcig kyang*/ /gtso mo'i phyag mtshan rnams ni kha dog gzhan/ /shar gyi g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ /'khor lo ljang gu ral gri mun pa'i mdog /dpag bsam shing nag dbyug pa ljang gu dang*/ /mdung dang shak+ti byu ru'i mdog can dang*/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i be con dbang sngon mtshungs/ /karke ta 'od rdo rje 'bar dang khab/ /ut+pal sngo mtshungs mdung rtse gsum pa dang*/ /kun+da'i mdog can sbrul zhags dgra sta'o/ /lte ba'i dbus su yab kyi mtshan ma ste/ /g.yon du yum mtshan kha dog thabs shes bsgyur/ /rim bzhin sngon po ser gnyis sngon po dang*/ /dkar gnyis ljang gu dkar min zung dang ni/ /margad mdog dang me'i mdog can zung*/ /sgo yi nang gi shing rta so so la/ /shar du dbyug pa nag dang be con ser/ / lho ru mda' dmar gtun shing dkar po dang*/ /byang du'ang de dang mtshungs par gtun shing mda'/ /nub tu'ang be con dbyug pa bri bar bya/ /shing rta rnams kyang phyogs kyi mdog can yin/ /steng du dgra sta ljang dang rdo rje sngo/ /'og tu rdo rje sngo dang rtse gsum ljang*/ /rta babs 'og ma'i dbus su 'khor lo nag /g.yas g.yon ri dwags pho mo gser mdog sogs/ /sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba ji bzhin du/ /phyi rol rdo rje bzhi po'ang dgod par bya/ /mi ci pho mo lha yi gzugs yin te/

/glang seng brtsegs dang sha la bhañdzi ka /gdung snang rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs bri/ /klu rnams mtshan ma bum pa nyid yin te/ /sku dkyil rta babs ka ba'i rtsa ba dang*/ /nye bar stegs bu'i steng du 'byung ba bzhi'i/ /dkyil 'khor rnams la tshul dang mthun par dgod/ /me dang rlung gi 'khor yug mtshams su ni/ /phyogs bzhir 'khor lo dmar dang mtshams bzhir dkar/ /rtsibs brgyad lte bar phyogs mdog gri gug re'o/ /klu dang rab gtum ma yi gdan rnams la/ /gtso bo gtso mo gang yin phyag mtshan te/ /'khyud pa'i yab yum rnams kyi mtshan ma min/ /gsung dang sku yi pad+ma'i lte ba dang*/ /dur khrod 'khor lo'i 'og tu srog gzugs rnams/ /'bri bar byed mod shin tu 'bri dka' na/ /thur ma sogs kyis ri mo btod kyang rung*/ /yi dwags dmar dang mkha' lding nag po dang*/ /ma he nyi 'od rma bya rang mdog dang*/ /glang chen ngang pa kha ba ku mud 'dra/ khyu mchog dkar dang seng ge de dang mtshungs/ /'di dag gsung gi rnal 'byor ma yi gdan/ /bya khyung sna lnga ro langs dmar po dang*/ /khri snyan rang mdog ma he sngo skya dang*/ /lug dkar gtsug phud can ni rang mdog ste/ /nor sbyin gdan la glang chen smug nag gam/ /khol po mi sha kha las ser mdangs can/ /glang chen ngang pa khyu mchog sngar bzhin te/ /chu srin dmar dang byi ba sngon po'o/ /de rnams tshes lha'i pad+ma'i lte bar ste/ /sgo skyong rnams kyi shing rta 'dren byed la/ /phag bdun nag dang rta bdun dmar ba dang*/ /glang chen bdun ser seng ge dkar po bdun/ /mkha' lding sna lnga bdun dang sha ra bha/ /nag po bdun te mtshon byed spungs pas rung*/ /dur khrod 'khor lo'i 'og tu srog chags ni/ /shar nas g.yas skor bse ru bya ser po/ /dom dang khrung khrung seng ge bya sngon po/ /g.yag dang pha waṃ bri bar bya ba ste/ /gsung sku'i stegs bur 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma'i/ /ut+pal na bza' 'khor lo ral gri dang*/

/gri gug shar sgo'i g.yas nas me zur bar/ /lho g.yon gri gug mda' dbyug dgra sta'o/ /pad+ma ro snod shak+ti lcags kyu dang*/ /gri gug nag rnams lho g.yas bden bral zur/ /nub g.yon gri gug rdo rje 'khor lo dang*/ /chos 'byung ljang khu rim bzhin bri bar bya/ /'khor lo dung chos par pu khab ser dang*/ /gri gug ser rnams nub g.yas rlung zur bar/ /byang g.yon zangs gri dkar po tri shu la/ /tho ba pi waṃ rim bzhin dgod par bya/ /ut+pal dkar dang me long pad dkar dang*/ /tho ba gri gug byang g.yas dbang ldan zur/ /shar g.yon gri gug rtse gsum ral gri dang*/ /rdo rje rwa gsum gdengs pa sngon po bri/ /de dag thams cad g.yas skor rim pa yin/ /gal re lha mtshan srog gzugs 'bri dka' na/ /khol mar btab kyang rung zhing mdzes pa yin/ /bum pa pad+ma mchod pa sna tshogs te/ /mtshon pa'i sa gzhi'i gdan la mdzes tshon rung*/ /sku yi rtsig pa'i nang rol thams cad du/ /mdzes byed blo bzo'i ri mo 'bri bar bkab/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor phyed kyi phyi ma la/ /mtshan ma nges med 'bri bar gsungs pas na/ /tshon spungs kha dog sna tshogs byas kyang rung*/ /sgo mkhyud mtshams kyi zla phyed rin chen dang*/ /rtsi gzur phyi la sna tshogs rdo rje 'bri/ /me yi khor yug phyed kyi phyi ma dang*/ /rlung gi phyed kyi nang ma'i gnas su ni/ /dur khrod mtshan ma spyi dang mtshungs pa'ang bya/ /yang na lha mtshan spangs te sa bon 'bri/ /skal med mdun ser sku brnyan mi 'god cing*/ /dur khrod mtshan ma'ang min zhes gzhan las bshad/ /'on kyang kha ba can gyi phyogs 'di na/ /dgag bya de ni yod min bris na legs/ /zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa la don tshan lnga las/ dang po rdul tshon gyi dpangs la dpyad pa ni/ rgyud 'grel las/ tshon gyi dpangs la reg bya la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi grangs kyi dag pas/ nag po la nas kyi rkang pa gcig /dmar po la gnyis/

dkar po la gsum/ ser po la bzhi zhes gsungs shing*/ don gyis na ljang sngo gnyis la nas kyi brgyad cha yin par gsal lo/ /yang na phyogs kyi rim pas kha dog gi dbye ba med par thugs kyi nyis 'gyur gsung dang*/ de'i nyis 'gyur sku la'ang gsungs pa/ phyi ma 'di sa stegs dbus mtho ba'i dbang du byas pa ste/ de bzhin du rwa ba rnams rdul tshon ser po'i dpangs las sum 'gyur dang*/ re kha gzhan rnams nyis 'gyur du gsungs pa 'di rnams deng sang lag len du 'debs dka' bas yid kyis mos pa bya zhing*/ go rim dang mthun pa'i srab 'thug gi khyad par cung zad byas na legs mod/ rwa ba rnams ser po'i sum 'gyur du byed pa sogs la kha cig nus pa'o snyam pa 'dug kyang*/ 'phrul gyi yan lag tu dgongs pa ma yin gyi/ thang chu'i khyad par sogs bsres pas dka' ba med ces bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta gsung ngo*/ /gzhan yang phyogs mdog gi gzhi la pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma'i steng du nyi zla sogs kyang brtsegs pa yin pas rdul tshon rim gyis mtho ba yin la/ 'khor yug gi sa la'ang rdul tshon nas gang tsam 'grem par gsungs so/ /nas zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor rang rang gi cha chung phyed la brgyad du bgos pa'i cha ste/ dkyil 'khor rang rang gi rtsa thig gi bdun brgya drug cu re brgyad kyi cha shas yin mod/ 'on kyang thugs dang gsung gi dkyil 'khor la/ nas kyi byed dang bzhi cha la nas su ming btags pa'ang yod gsung ngo*// don tshan gnyis pa mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog pa ni/ de ltar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la/ rgyud las/ gal te rdul tshon rlung gis khyer na 'jigs pa gsal byed yul 'khor dag tu rgyal pos 'jigs pa yang*/ /zhes pa lta bu'i gnod pa las bsrung zhing*/ yang ji skad du/ sboms pas nad dag byed cing phra dang re kha ngan pas rdzas ni nyam pa rab tu gsal bar byed/ /chad pas 'chi ba dang ni 'khyog pos mi yi bdag po dang bcas grong brdal de bzhin nyid du bskyod/

/mtshan ma nyi ma zla ba chad na sngags pa rnams la srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa'i dngos grub med/ /rnam par 'dres pas rigs brgyad 'chad de rgyal ba'i rigs kyis dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dag la rig par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyes dmigs shes nas gzab par bya la/ yang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa de dag mthong nas slar yang gtso bo dag gi sngags kyi bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thig dang tshon gyi skabs su mtshan ma ngan pa dag byung na gong bdud bgegs tshar gcod pa'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar gtor ma dang*/ bzlas pa la brtson pa dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ phur bus gdab pa sogs la 'bad de/ bzlog pa'i rtags byung gi bar du rtsom pa mi 'dor bar bya'o// don tshan gsum pa phyogs mdog la dpyad pa ni/ skabs 'dir ye le'i zhe gsum pa'i 'grel bar des na thugs rnam par dag pas shar du dpal ldan nag po'i sar 'gyur ro/ /gsung rnam par dag pas lhor nyi ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /ye shes kyi zhal rnam par dag pas nub tu gser mdog ste ser po'o/ /sku'i zhal rnam par dag pas byang du yang gzhan te dkar po'o/ /de ltar rdo rje can gyi zhal gyi dbye bas phyogs rnams su rdul tshon dgye bar bya'o/ /zhes phyogs bzhi'i dbye ba gsungs kyi/ phyogs brgyad kyi dbye ba ye ma gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'di skad ces/ shar du rlung rnam par dag pas thugs rdo rje kha dog nag po sa'i cha la khyab par byed pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ zhal gyi dbye ba'i don phyogs bzhi la zhal re re ste zhal bzhi yin la/ mtshams rnams la zhal gnyis kyi bar mtshams ma gtogs/ drang thad kyi zhal ma byung bas mdun zhal dang g.yas zhal gyi sa gzhi'i mtshams shar lho'i zur thig la 'ong gi phyogs phyogs mtshams mnyam par bcad pa'i shar lho'i dum bu rtsa zhal gyi sa'i phyir yin na/ shar drang thad la rtsa zhal gyi 'khur tshos g.yon pa'i zur ston par 'gyur bas/ ltag pa dang mgul phyir gcus pa'am/

ma gcus na bzhugs tshul 'khyogs par 'gyur te sku gzugs kyi dbyibs sngon med blo bzo ma yong bas rang bzo 'di lta bu mi bya'o/ /zhal gyi dbye bas gsungs pa nyid kyi phyir/ zhal bzhi la phyogs bzhi'i dbye ba bya yi/ zhal brgyad med bzhin du phyogs brgyad kyi dbye ba mi bya'o/ /phyogs brgyad byed na zhal brgyad dang yang sbyor dgos kyang*/ zhal brgyad pa'i skabs su ni nges par yang zur thig la mtshams byed pa 'grub kyi/ shar shar lho nag po sogs mi 'grub bo/ /de bzhin du rgyud las/ phyogs kyi cha la tshon gyi sar ni mi yi bdag po sangs rgyas dbye bas rdul tshon gdab par 'gyur/ /zhes tshon sa'i phyogs kyi kha dog rgyal ba rigs bzhi'i dbye bas byed ces gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas bzhi phyogs bzhi na yod kyi mtshams na med pas/ mtshams rnams zhar byung du btang ste/ me mtshams kyi dum bu las/ shar dang nye ba rnams shar gyi kha dog dang*/ lho dang nye ba rnams lho'i kha dog tu byed pa sogs kyi don yin gyi/ shar dang shar lho nag po dang*/ lho dang lho nub dmar po sogs byed na/ phyogs dang mtshams kyi cha la sangs rgyas bzhi dang yum bzhi ste brgyad kyi dbye bas rdul tshon gdab ces gsung dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang yongs 'joms kyi skabs su thabs la shes rab dang*/ shes rab la thabs rgyu ba legs par 'gyur zhing*/ thabs dang thabs nang 'khrug /shes rab dang shes rab nang 'khrugs pas yongs 'joms yin la/ de yang me rlung gi zur thig nyid la mtshams 'chol bar mdzad na/ khyed kyi lugs la shar lho nag po rlung dang*/ nub byang ser po sa khams yin zhing*/ de yang shar lho'i zur thig nas lho'i tshangs thig gi bar la phyed mar btang ba'i phyed shar ma/ zur thig las lho phyogs su 'phags pa'i sa der slob dpon phyin na yongs 'joms su 'gyur te/ rlung khams thabs kyi sa la slob dpon thabs 'ongs pas so/

/de bzhin du/ nub byang gi phyed shar ma la slob ma'ang de dang 'dra bas/ yongs 'joms kyi sa mtshams zur thig la gsungs pa'i rigs pas kyang phyogs mdog 'khyog po 'di shin tu gsal bar bkag go /yang 'di skad du/ lha'i mtshan ma 'god pa'i skabs su shar dang mer nag po zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ de nyid zhal gyi dbye ba yang yin par bshad do/ /zhes zer ro/ /'di yang slob dpon gyi zhal gyis dman pa'i sbom yor ba rnams kyi blo ngor 'dra rung byung yang don ma yin te/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du bcad pa'i shar lho na yod pa'i lha thams cad nag po ma yin te/ yin na gshin rje'i 'khor tshogs phyed nag por thal lo/ /des na 'dir rang lugs ni dper na me mtshams kyi lhar gsungs tshad zur thig gi sa khul gyi steng na gnas pa yin la/ de las gzhi dmar nag gnyis ka'i cha yod kyang nag po gtso che ba yin pas/ der gnas pa'i lha dang mtshan ma nag por 'gyur ro/ /des na shar drang thad ni rlung khams kho na yin la/ shar lho'i mtshams drang thad ni/ gtso bo rlung la 'khor me yod pa yin pas/ gnas skabs gzhan du shar lho rlung du bshad pa'ang yod mod gtso che bar dgongs so/ / g.yas skor gyi rim pas bgrod pa'i dbang du byed na/ shar nas brtsams te shar lho'i mtshams su phyin pa na/ mtshams der 'byung ba gnyis kar 'dzom yang*/ rlung ni snga rol nas 'grogs te yun ring lon pa'i gdod ma yin la/ me ni phrad ma thag pa yin pas me bas rlung stobs che ba yin no/ /des thams cad la 'gre ste/ de yang dge ba'i las dang mchog sgrub la g.yas skor du brtsi zhing*/ dge min gyi las la g.yon skor du brtsi ba'ang yod na/ 'dir ni g.yas skor ro/ / gzhan yang rnam pa gcig tu na lha'i mtshan ma'i skabs su/ shar shar lho nag po sogs kun tu grags shing gsungs la/ sa gzhi'i phyogs mdog la de 'dra ma gsungs pa nyid kyis gzhi'i phyogs mdog gi mtshams zur thig la byed par grub bo/

/'o na ye le'i nyer bdun pa'i 'grel par shar dang mer nag po dang*/ lho dang bden bral du dmar po dang*/ nub dang rlung du ser po dang*/ byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lung gsal kha dang bcas pa'i phyir/ gzhi'i phyogs mdog shar shar lho nag po sogs 'di kho na'o snyam na/ de ni sdom chen gyi sgos chos yin pas dus kyi 'khor lo nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan la mi rung ngo*/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang dkyil 'khor de la sgo brgyad yod cing*/ de'i zur thig kyang don gyi tshangs thig yin pas/ tshangs thig la mtshams 'chol ba dang*/ sgo la kha dog phyed tshal du gtong ba dkyil 'khor gang gi lugs la yang mi rung bas rgyu mtshan de'i phyir de la de yin no/ /de lta bas na dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor la ni/ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi yin la/ sdom chen la ni phyogs brgyad mtshams brgyad yin te/ sgo brgyad dang dur khrod bcu drug gi rig pas so/ /'di yang bla ma'i zhal lung med par shes rab che ru re bas dpe sgrogs byed pa rnams la 'khrul gzhi skye ba ni bden par snang ngo*/ / don tshan bzhi pa dag pa bshad pa ni/ de ltar bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa de la dag sbyor gyi rim pa mang du gsungs pa las/ phyi 'jig rten khams la sbyor tshul gcig ni/ 'jig rten khams mnyam gyi dag par grags pa de yin te/ gzhan du brjod zin to/ /yang rnam grangs gcig la/ lus kyi dpyi man chad du sor drug pa brgyad yod pa ni/ dmyal ba bdun dang klu'i gnas te brgyad dag pa sku'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor ni phyi rol tu lhun po dang*/ nang du sgal tshigs te dpyi nas mgrin pa'i 'og mtshams kyi bar ro/ /ri rab kyi mgrin pa dang lus kyi mgrin pa dang*/ gdong gi phyed 'og ma ni tshon sa phan chad thugs dkyil dngos dang sbyor zhing*/ ri rab kyi gdong dang lus kyi gdong gi phyed gong ma ni/
